title: Is this Citation on Point?
abstract: arXiv:2608.12571v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In 2023, a New York judge sanctioned two attorneys in Mata v. Avianca for filing a brief with hallucinated citations generated by ChatGPT. Such failures are largely caught by database lookups; the harder problem is detecting citations that point to real cases but do not support the propositions for which they are offered -- a failure mode that existing evaluations of LLMs for legal use cases largely overlook. In this paper, we study proposition-level citation support verification through controlled perturbations of real legal citations obtained from two legal corpora, either replacing the cited case or changing only the pinpoint page within the same case. We evaluate fourteen model configurations on the resulting examples. Models catch 93-100% of wrong-case corruptions. translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12571v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：2023年，纽约一名法官在Mata诉Avianca案中制裁了两名律师，因为他们提交的辩护状中包含由ChatGPT生成的虚构引用。这类失败大多可通过数据库查找发现；更棘手的问题是检测那些指向真实案例但并未支持所主张论点的引用——这一失败模式在现有针对法律用例的大语言模型评估中大多被忽视。在本文中，我们通过从两个法律语料库中获取的真实法律引用的受控扰动，研究命题级引用支持验证，方法包括替换被引案例或仅更改同一案例内的精确定位页。我们在所得示例上评估了十四种模型配置。模型能捕捉93-100%的错误案例替换。但对于法院意见中的错误精确定位，模型仅能捕捉37-61%，在法律辩护状中为52-83%。当模型未能捕捉错误精确定位时，它们会接受该引用。
tldr: 本研究通过受控扰动实验发现，现有大语言模型在法律引用验证中能有效识别错误案例，但对同一案例内错误页码的检测能力显著不足，且这一失败模式在现有评估中常被忽视。
en_tdlr: This study reveals through controlled perturbation experiments that current LLMs effectively detect wrong-case legal citations but significantly underperform at identifying wrong pinpoint citations within the same case, a failure mode largely overlooked in existing evaluations.
